name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat or soft surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Press through your feet to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
technique_considerations: Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back at the top.
Push through your whole foot, with your heels staying on the floor.
Rest your arms by your sides with palms down for balance.
